notes: 2.3.25 rebuilds the setup wizard: a branded side rail showing every step, a welcome screen with what setup covers and how long it takes, school-kind cards, a masked PIN with a show/hide eye and a strong-PIN hint, and a final screen summarising your school, online account, PIN and licence before you open the dashboard. 2.3.26 lets a new or repaired computer sign in to the school account and pull that school's cloud copy instead of creating a second empty school, and shows the account password so it can be written down.
